get_cities.doc: Get a paginated list of cities for a given country. Calls the yp_get_cities stored procedure on the YP database using the supplied country ID and page number.

id.description: Country ID used to filter the city list

returns.description: Paginated city list result from the yp_get_cities stored procedure

data.description: Array of city records for the specified country

get_countries.doc: Get a paginated list of all countries. Calls the utils_get_countries stored procedure on the YP database. Supports pagination via page and length parameters.

length.description: Number of records to return per page

returns.description: Paginated country list result from the utils_get_countries stored procedure

search_cities.doc: Search cities by name keyword. Calls the utils_search_cities stored procedure on the YP database. Accepts the search term via either the value or name parameter, falling back to an empty string when both are absent.

value.description: Search keyword for city name. Takes priority over the name parameter when both are supplied.

name.description: Alternative search keyword for city name. Used when value is not provided.

returns.description: Paginated city search result from the utils_search_cities stored procedure

data.description: Array of city records matching the search keyword

search_countries.doc: Search countries by name keyword. Calls the utils_search_countries stored procedure on the YP database. Accepts the search term via either the value or name parameter, falling back to an empty string when both are absent.

value.description: Search keyword for country name. Takes priority over the name parameter when both are supplied.

name.description: Alternative search keyword for country name. Used when value is not provided.

returns.description: Paginated country search result from the utils_search_countries stored procedure

data.description: Array of country records matching the search keyword
